lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I take out the Love Arrow from my pocket.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: The person I will be giving this arrow to is:
Naga.
Tia.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: It was always her from the very beginning.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Naga. Mature and considerate. Always taking care of those around her.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: A whip-smart intellect. I often forget she's still a student.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: My mind made up, I proceed towards the classroom.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Squeak*

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Teacher?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Naga.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Just a moment.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I'm in the middle of putting my hair up.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I didn't know you'd come here this fast.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: If I'm being completely honest...

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I wasn't sure if you would come at all.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: What's going on?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: My... my hands are shaking.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I guess I'm nervous now that you're here.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Don't be.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Am I just imagining it,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: or is your voice shaking too?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I'm not sure

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I have the willpower to look you in the eye, so

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: would it be okay if you just listened to my voice?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Okay.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Thank you.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: You're really special.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: You've always been different from the other teachers.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Usually, they don't care all that much about the students.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Any improvements made on our part are strictly for military purposes. Sure, they usually provide a moderate amount of attention as needed, but not much more than that.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: So, when I asked you about extra lessons, I didn't expect you to agree.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: But you always made time for me.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Not only that, but you were glad to do it.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I think that was when

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: you had a special place in my heart.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: It wasn't just me who felt that way, either. Lots of other students started gathering around you.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Seeing everyone else's reaction to you made me sure of my thoughts.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: That you were real.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: You were the perfect teacher that I had always dreamed of.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: And now you've come to me.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: So, it's safe to say that I'm rather nervous.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: My hands keep shaking. I can't even tie up my hair.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Just a second...

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Phew, okay.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Done.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: What do you think?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Does it look good?

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Naga smiles expectantly at me, and I tell her the truth.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: It looks fantastic.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Hehe... I'm glad.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I put effort into trying to look my best.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Here.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: This is your gift.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: It's actually happening...

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: The Love Arrow...

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I can't believe how it stirred up so much jealousy in me before.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: When you said that you wanted to give it to someone who felt right,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: it was as if all your feelings were tied to this arrow.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I don't want to see you with anyone else.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Naga extends her hand.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Will you give me your hand?

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: When I hold out my hand, Naga gently prods my palm with the tip of the arrow.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Now that you've been touched by the arrow,

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: that means your heart belongs to me from here on out, doesn't it?

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Naga leans her head on my chest.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Can we stay like this?

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: Just for a moment.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Instead of answering with words, I stroke her hair slowly.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Meanwhile, Tia, who was not chosen...

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: *Sob*

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: *Sob*

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: *Sob*

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Teacher...

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: He's late.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Maybe he has a lot of work today.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: He's not answering any of my messages or calls.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Or... Perhaps...

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Did he... go to Naga?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: *Sob*

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: That hurts.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: It was always her from the very beginning.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Her cheerful smile that lit up any room that she was in.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: That bright ray of sunshine. Tia.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: My mind made up, I proceed towards the Maid Cafe.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Ring*

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: After arriving, I look around, but there is no sight of Tia.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Tia?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I came to give you the arrow...

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Not a single soul is around.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: As I continue to scan the cafe...

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: *Rustle*

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: My eyes are covered by something soft.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Gotcha!

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Tia? What are you doing?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I want to surprise you.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I feel Tia take the arrow from my hand.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Is this why you came here?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: To give this to me?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Yes.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Oh my gosh... I'm so happy!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Is it okay if I use it now?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I just can't wait!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Ready or not, here it comes.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Ow!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Now that I've pricked you with this arrow,

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: you're mine, got that? Hehe.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Is this the surprise you had in store for me?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Hmm?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Oh no, no no no.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Follow me.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Right this way.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I let Tia lead me along.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: There is a chair here, so come in slowly.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: And take a seat.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Well done, Teacher.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Promise me you won't open your eyes, okay?

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: After removing the cloth covering my eyes,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: I hear Tia preparing something.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: All finished!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Okay, you can open your eyes.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: A dessert feast that I made just for you.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: How do you like it?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I gathered as many delicious treats as I could.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: It wasn't easy to make, I can tell you that.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: I'm touched. Thank you.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I'm the one who's moved. You brought the arrow here, after all.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Here, take a bite.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Open up and say aahhhhh.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Are you not going to take a photo?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Huh? What photo?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Oh!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: You mean a photo of the dessert?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: No, it's okay.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: This is all meant for you, not me.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Now open up.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: It's absolutely fantastic.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Hehe.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I'm glad you like it.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: It's worth all the hard work.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Seeing you this happy makes me happy.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I'm so glad that

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: you take an interest in the things I like and the things I do.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Especially when I'm taking photos of desserts.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: You never get angry or complain. Most people usually just leave.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: But not you. You always waited patiently for me and never uttered a word of protest.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: That makes me admire you even more.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: That's how a real adult should act.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: So for once, I wanted to give you that same feeling.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: You have no idea how long I've been waiting for this moment.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Eons, an eternity... no.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Words cannot describe

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: how excruciatingly long I've dreamt of this moment.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Now it's really happening, and I couldn't be happier.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: It's sweeter than any dessert I've ever eaten.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Today will be the sweetest day of my life.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Just a moment.

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I'll go get the rest of the desserts, okay?

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: Wait a minute.

lines.speaker: Self
lines.text: There's more?

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: Of course!

lines.speaker: tia
lines.text: I brought enough to last us the entire night.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: Beaming from ear to ear, Tia disappears into the kitchen.

lines.speaker: Narration
lines.text: Meanwhile, Naga, who was not chosen...

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: He hasn't looked at his phone.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: And he hasn't shown up...

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I suppose he went to see Tia.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: It hurts more than I thought it would.

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: *Sigh*

lines.speaker: naga
lines.text: I suppose I should head back now.

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: As the sun went down, I handed the Love Arrow to the girl who filled my heart,

lines.speaker: Monologue
lines.text: and we spent an unforgettable evening together until it was late at night.
